dc_max_kw.notes: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Extended Range (20 MOD) pack. 670 V up to 300 kW. Several existing Extended Range records say 350 kW (the Max pack's value); this is the GM figure for the 20-module pack. The Weekly Driver 20-module page also gives 300 kW. The existing 350 kW on some 2026 Extended Range records is the Max Range figure.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM 2026 guide: "19.2 kW module on 5WT and 8WT" (5WT = Extended Range WT); the 2025 guide lists "AC Offboarding Power (5WT, 8WT) 10.2 kW with 19.2 kW module". Same WT Extended Range hardware as the 2026 guide (2025 and 2026 compared).

published_10_80_min.notes: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Extended Range (20 MOD) pack. Low-80% time to charge 42 min and 111 miles added in 10 min; column mapping to this pack inferred from the page layout (4WT 74 mi, 5WT 111 mi, 8WT 124 mi). The guide row is labelled "Low-80% time to charge", not 10-80 %.
